claims.text: Bolas spiders catch moths by swinging a sticky globule on a silk thread.
Garden orb-weavers, wolf spiders and trapdoor spiders do not hunt by swinging a sticky ball on a thread.
Bolas spiders give off chemicals that mimic the sex pheromones of female moths.
The moths that bolas spiders catch are mostly males drawn in by the mimicked scent.
